name: pob-redux
description: Path of Building for Path of Exile 1 and 2, rebuilt.

scripts.sync: cargo run -p pob-sync -- --tree-assets && cargo run -p pob-sync -- --game poe1 --tree-assets
scripts.sync:fast: cargo run -p pob-sync -- && cargo run -p pob-sync -- --game poe1
scripts.golden: cargo run -p pob-engine --bin pobctl -- --pob-root src-tauri/resources/pob golden corpus/poe2/index.json --out target/golden-poe2.json --baseline golden/poe2.json --check
scripts.golden:accept: cargo run -p pob-engine --bin pobctl -- --pob-root src-tauri/resources/pob golden corpus/poe2/index.json --out golden/poe2.json
scripts.golden:poe1: cargo run -p pob-engine --bin pobctl -- --pob-root src-tauri/resources/pob1 golden corpus/poe1/index.json --out target/golden-poe1.json --baseline golden/poe1.json --check
scripts.golden:poe1:accept: cargo run -p pob-engine --bin pobctl -- --pob-root src-tauri/resources/pob1 golden corpus/poe1/index.json --out golden/poe1.json
